title: Costco Wholesale, FY2023 vs FY2022

attempts.text: Costco Wholesale Corporation reported a year-over-year increase in revenue of 6.8%, marking a significant boost of $15.3 billion from the previous year. Operating cash flow also saw a substantial increase of $3.68 billion, reflecting a notable improvement in the company's liquidity and financial health. Capital expenditure, which increased by 11.1%, further solidifies Costco's commitment to expanding its physical retail footprint and enhancing its operational capabilities. These financial metrics indicate a robust performance and a solid foundation for future growth.

In FY2023, Costco Wholesale Corporation experienced a significant increase in revenue of 6.8% compared to the prior year, reaching $242.3 billion. This substantial growth is attributed to an increase in operating income of 4.1% and a rise in net income of 7.7%, totaling $8.11 billion and $6.29 billion, respectively. Operating cash flow increased by 49.7%, reaching $11.07 billion, while capital expenditure increased by 11.1%, totaling $4.32 billion. These financial metrics indicate a robust performance in FY2023, with a focus on improving liquidity and committing to significant investments in operations and capital expenditures.

In FY2023, Costco Wholesale Corporation experienced a revenue increase of 6.8% compared to the prior year, marking a significant growth in its operations. This year-over-year growth was driven by an increase in operating income of 4.1%, which was partially offset by a 0.08 percentage point decrease in operating margin. The company's largest revenue contributors were operating cash flow and capital expenditure, which both increased by 49.7% and 11.1% respectively. These figures highlight the company's financial health and its ability to invest in its operations and growth.

final_text: Costco revenue was $242.3bn in FY2023, up 6.8% from $227.0bn in FY2022. Operating margin was 3.35% (down 0.08 pp), with SG&A at 8.91% of revenue. The largest movements were: Operating cash flow increased by $3.68bn; Capital expenditure increased by $0.43bn; SG&A increased by $1.81bn.
